functional.text: Shorten: given a long URL (optionally a custom alias), create a unique short URL.
Redirect: visiting a short URL redirects to the original long URL.
Links expire after 5 years by default; owners can delete them.
Count clicks per link (analytics), best effort.

non_functional.text: Low latency redirects: p99 < 50 ms; read-heavy, ~100 reads per write.
High availability for redirects (99.99%); brief write unavailability is tolerable.
Short codes are not guessable in sequence.

assumptions.text: 100M new links per month; ~500 bytes per stored record.

api.notes: Idempotent per (owner, long_url) with an Idempotency-Key header.
The hot path: served from cache.

data.name: links
data.why: Pure key → value lookups by code; scales horizontally by hashing the code.

data.name: click_counts
data.why: Written by the analytics worker in batches.

deep_dives.title: Short code generation

options.name: hash(long_url) truncated
options.cons: collisions must be detected and retried

options.name: range-leased counter + base62
options.cons: needs a range allocator; sequential unless shuffled

deep_dives.why: Each service instance leases a block of 1M ids from a coordinator, encodes them in base62 (7 chars ≈ 3.5e12 codes) and applies a reversible bit shuffle so codes are not sequential.

deep_dives.title: Redirect status
deep_dives.why: Click analytics is a requirement; the cache in front of the store absorbs the extra load.

wrapup.bottlenecks: The id range allocator (mitigated: ranges are leased in large blocks and cached), hot codes concentrating on one cache shard (replicate hot keys), the primary of each store shard (replicas + multi-AZ).
wrapup.failures: If the cache is down, reads fall back to the store with rate limiting; if the stream is down, click events are dropped (best effort) but redirects continue.
wrapup.monitoring: p50/p99 redirect latency, cache hit ratio, 404 and 5xx rates, stream consumer lag; alerts on SLO burn rate.
wrapup.scale: 10× growth: add redirect instances behind the load balancer, more cache shards, and more store partitions keyed by code hash.
wrapup.future: Custom domains, link previews and abuse detection (malware URLs).
